summary: Tested Activity Feed Enhancement (iteration 111). All 10 features working correctly. Backend APIs (POST /api/crm/v2/activities with owner_id/owner_name, GET /api/crm/users org-filtered) pass all tests. Frontend shows 'Activity Feed' in sidebar with Activity icon, staff filter defaults to 'My Activities', manager sees 'All Staff' option, type filters work, create dialog has company-first contact filtering.

feature_1_sidebar_renamed.details: Sidebar nav item shows 'Activity Feed' label with Activity icon (data-testid='crm-nav-inbox')

feature_3_manager_all_staff_option.details: Craig (manager role) sees 'All Staff' option in staff filter dropdown

feature_4_staff_filter_works.details: 'My Activities' shows 55 activities, 'All Staff' shows all org activities - filtering by owner_id works

feature_5_type_filter_buttons.details: All 7 type filter buttons found: all, note, call, email, meeting, task, system. Clicking 'Tasks' shows 19 task activities.

feature_6_detail_panel_linked_entities.details: Detail panel shows activity info with Delete button. Linked entity buttons (data-testid='linked-company', 'linked-deal') render when activity has company_id/opportunity_id

feature_7_create_dialog_company_first.details: Create Activity dialog (data-testid='create-activity-dialog') shows 'Select company first...' in Contact dropdown until company is selected

feature_8_search_filters.details: Search input (data-testid='inbox-search') filters by subject/body/owner_name. Search for 'Stage changed' returned 17 results.

feature_9_post_activities_owner.details: POST /api/crm/v2/activities creates activity with owner_id and owner_name from logged-in user

feature_10_get_users_org_filtered.details: GET /api/crm/users returns only users from the same organization (Craig's org)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed activities during testing (cleaned up)
